question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
This great accomplishment relates to the yoginis
A practitioner may become dear through this attainment
inference: One who attains the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis
plain_english: Through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginis.
